quests.title: The Great Mountain Survey II

dialogue.t: So c—cold... Can we g—go now...
A beacon placed right at the summit will be sure to minimize the margin of error in my measurements...
Did you put the beacon in place?
Wonderful! Thank you, now I can finally get a reliable measurement of the height of the mountain.
Oh, and regarding compensation — I asked Cyrus to put something together. Ask him for it next time you're in the city.

And since you'll see him before I do, could you also give him this letter for me? He promised to keep me in the loop about a second exploration team headed for the mountains, but I still haven't heard back about it.
Once the rest of my beacons are fixed, I'll have to head back up and set them all up. There's a lot of things that still need surveying on that mountain.

dialogue.sit: I have a letter for you.

dialogue.t: A letter? ...Oh, it's from her. I'll wager she's asking about the next exploration team again...
*sigh* I don't know what I can do. It's rare to find a team that's willing to take on the mountain these days — it's just too dangerous up there...
I'll write her a letter shortly to explain the situation. Thank you for making the trip to deliver this.
Speaking of letters, she sent another not long ago asking me to prepare a reward for you. Here, please take it.
One last thing... I can see that you are a hardy type, but nevertheless — I urge you to be careful in the mountains.
Ah, Dragonspine... If ever the chance arose to lead a team of explorers there in person, I would surely take it!
*sigh* When will I finally be able to head back up the mountain...

quests.description: Though the beacons have all been placed, Esther remains unable to measure Dragonspine’s true height, seemingly due to having insufficient beacons. To resolve the issue, she is looking for someone who can help her plant a beacon directly at the mountain’s summit…
